# 运行设置全表

运行设置存在 `runtime_settings` 表里，由控制台的「运维 → 运行设置」编辑。它们**覆盖**环境变量，多数改动热生效，不需要重启进程。
「字段」列是 Go 结构体字段名，用于在代码里定位该设置；「键」列是持久化与 API 使用的名字。
没有出现在这张表里的开关只存在于环境变量层——想彻底关掉某个后台任务，两处都要看。

共 **62** 个运行设置键。

| 键 | 字段 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `retry_times` | RetryTimes | int | — |
| `cross_channel_failover_enabled` | CrossChannelFailoverEnabled | bool | — |
| `cooldown_seconds` | CooldownSeconds | int | — |
| `checkin_enabled` | CheckinEnabled | bool | — |
| `checkin_cron` | CheckinCron | string | — |
| `discovery_cron` | DiscoveryCron | string | DiscoveryCron is the scheduled model-list refresh expression (five-field cron; empty = disabled). Same format as checkin_cron. |
| `probe_cron` | ProbeCron | string | ProbeCron is the scheduled model-probe expression (five-field cron; empty = disabled). The probe_* fields below configure that run: a probe is a real upstream call, so its scope and cost stay explicit. |
| `probe_prompt` | ProbePrompt | string | ProbePrompt is the user message the scheduled probe sends; empty means the built-in default. |
| `probe_max_tokens` | ProbeMaxTokens | int | — |
| `probe_concurrency` | ProbeConcurrency | int | — |
| `probe_auto_disable` | ProbeAutoDisable | int | ProbeAutoDisable is the consecutive-failure threshold at which the scheduled run disables a member; 0 leaves routing untouched. |
| `probe_channels` | ProbeChannels | []int64 | ProbeChannels and ProbeModels scope the scheduled run. Empty means every model of every route on every channel. |
| `probe_models` | ProbeModels | []string | — |
| `db_gc_cron` | DBGCCron | string | DBGCCron is the scheduled database maintenance expression (orphan GC + VACUUM; empty = disabled). |
| `relay_rate_per_minute` | RelayRatePerMinute | int | — |
| `relay_rate_burst` | RelayRateBurst | int | — |
| `admin_rate_per_minute` | AdminRatePerMinute | int | — |
| `admin_rate_burst` | AdminRateBurst | int | — |
| `audit_retention_days` | AuditRetentionDays | int | — |
| `audit_retention_rows` | AuditRetentionRows | int | — |
| `channel_auto_disable_threshold` | ChannelAutoDisableThreshold | int | ChannelAutoDisableThreshold: consecutive failures before auto-disable (0 = feature off). RoutingLatencyAware enables latency-weighted picking. |
| `routing_latency_aware` | RoutingLatencyAware | bool | — |
| `routing_error_aware` | RoutingErrorAware | bool | RoutingErrorAware penalizes channels with a high EWMA failure propensity. |
| `routing_concurrency_enabled` | RoutingConcurrencyEnabled | bool | RoutingConcurrencyEnabled enables the in-flight burst guard. |
| `routing_concurrency_limit` | RoutingConcurrencyLimit | int | RoutingConcurrencyLimit is the per-channel in-flight ceiling. |
| `webhook_url` | WebhookURL | string | WebhookURL is the operational notification endpoint ("" disables). |
| `proxy_url` | ProxyURL | string | ProxyURL is the global outbound HTTP(S) proxy; "" = direct. Channels with their own proxy_url override it. |
| `webhook_throttle_seconds` | WebhookThrottleSeconds | int | WebhookThrottleSeconds coalesces repeated events within the window. |
| `stable_first_enabled` | StableFirstEnabled | bool | StableFirstEnabled gates the 1/N grayscale pool. |
| `stable_first_denominator` | StableFirstDenominator | int | StableFirstDenominator is the draw base (25 = grayscale gets 1/25). |
| `stable_first_promote_requests` | StableFirstPromoteRequests | int | StableFirstPromoteRequests is the successful-attempt threshold for automatic promotion out of the grayscale pool. |
| `recovery_probe_enabled` | RecoveryProbeEnabled | bool | RecoveryProbeEnabled enables the passive-recovery loop that probes auto-disabled channels and restores them when the upstream answers. |
| `recovery_probe_interval_seconds` | RecoveryProbeIntervalSeconds | int | RecoveryProbeIntervalSeconds is how often the recovery loop runs. |
| `fault_protection_enabled` | FaultProtectionEnabled | bool | FaultProtectionEnabled gates fixed cooldown and channel auto-disable. |
| `sticky_enabled` | StickyEnabled | bool | StickyEnabled enables sticky-session routing (same conversation prefers the previously successful channel). StickyTTLMinutes is the binding TTL. |
| `sticky_ttl_minutes` | StickyTTLMinutes | int | — |
| `alert_config_json` | AlertConfigJSON | string | AlertConfigJSON is the multi-channel alert matrix (webhook/bark/ serverchan/telegram/smtp + cooldown + daily summary flag). Empty string keeps the env bootstrap ("" itself disables all alert channels). |
| `alert_sweep_interval_seconds` | AlertSweepIntervalSeconds | int | AlertSweepIntervalSeconds is the proactive health sweep cadence (0 = off). |
| `alert_daily_summary_interval_seconds` | AlertDailySummaryIntervalSeconds | int | AlertDailySummaryIntervalSeconds is the daily digest cadence (0 = off). |
| `health_sweep_enabled` | HealthSweepEnabled | bool | HealthSweepEnabled turns on the periodic channel health sweep that grades every enabled channel operational/degraded/error and alerts on transitions. |
| `health_sweep_interval_seconds` | HealthSweepIntervalSeconds | int | — |
| `health_sweep_jitter_seconds` | HealthSweepJitterSeconds | int | — |
| `health_sweep_degraded_ms` | HealthSweepDegradedMs | int | — |
| `health_sweep_concurrency` | HealthSweepConcurrency | int | — |
| `health_sweep_timeout_seconds` | HealthSweepTimeoutSeconds | int | — |
| `channel_retry_times` | ChannelRetryTimes | int | ChannelRetryTimes is how many times the same upstream key is re-sent after a retryable failure before moving to the next key/channel (0-5). |
| `update_check_enabled` | UpdateCheckEnabled | bool | UpdateCheckEnabled lets the gateway query GitHub for a newer release to power the console update badge. Off means no outbound calls at all. |
| `default_model_sync_mode` | DefaultModelSyncMode | string | DefaultModelSyncMode is the sync mode ("auto"\|"manual") new channels get when the create request omits model_sync_mode. Existing channels keep their own mode. |
| `site_probe_interval_seconds` | SiteProbeIntervalSeconds | int | SiteProbeIntervalSeconds / SiteProbeJitterSeconds drive the external site-probe collection loop. The cadence has to be configurable because sites publish their own probe data at wildly different rates: a status page that polls every 60s is useless at the 15-minute default, while one that polls every 15 minutes gains nothing from a faster round. |
| `site_probe_jitter_seconds` | SiteProbeJitterSeconds | int | — |
| `site_news_interval_seconds` | SiteNewsIntervalSeconds | int | SiteNewsIntervalSeconds drives the upstream notice-board reader (internal/sitenews). It differs from the site-probe pair on one point: 0 means OFF — the scheduled read stops and only the dashboard's refresh button reads boards — while -1 (unset) resolves to the env bootstrap. |
| `keepalive_enabled` | KeepaliveEnabled | bool | KeepaliveEnabled is the keepalive master switch; the per-site window and the per-channel switch live in the database, because the window is the site's own rule (15 days here, 30 there). DefaultIdleDays is the fallback window for a site that was never given one, and CheckIntervalSeconds is how often a round asks whether anything is due. |
| `keepalive_check_interval_seconds` | KeepaliveCheckIntervalSeconds | int | — |
| `keepalive_default_idle_days` | KeepaliveDefaultIdleDays | int | — |
| `outbound_connect_timeout_seconds` | OutboundConnectTimeoutSeconds | int | Outbound client limits. They are runtime settings because the header ceiling is what decides whether a slow upstream dies at 60s: the image endpoints needed 5 minutes and the fix used to require a .env edit and a container recreate. 0 = the deployment default (OUTBOUND_* in the environment); a non-zero value is an override that survives restarts. |
| `outbound_header_timeout_seconds` | OutboundHeaderTimeoutSeconds | int | — |
| `outbound_image_header_timeout_seconds` | OutboundImageHeaderTimeoutSeconds | int | — |
| `outbound_tls_timeout_seconds` | OutboundTLSTimeoutSeconds | int | — |
| `outbound_max_idle_conns` | OutboundMaxIdleConns | int | — |
| `outbound_max_idle_conns_per_host` | OutboundMaxIdleConnsPerHost | int | — |
| `relay_max_body_mb` | RelayMaxBodyMB | int | RelayMaxBodyMB / RelayMaxImageMB are the /v1 request-body ceilings in megabytes, for the same reason as the outbound limits above: the ceiling is what refuses an ordinary request (a chat call with inlined base64 screenshots), and 0 means the deployment default (RELAY_MAX_*_MB) applies. |
| `relay_max_image_mb` | RelayMaxImageMB | int | — |

## 环境变量与运行设置的关系

- 进程启动时，环境变量是**初始值**；控制台保存的值成为**覆盖**，优先于环境变量。
- 清空一个覆盖（而不是设成 0）才会回落到环境变量值——`0` 通常是一个有意义的取值（关闭）。
- 热生效的边界由各项的 applier 决定：涉及重建后台循环的改动会在下一个周期生效。
